# Victoria 3 Lite: generated by tools/gen_vanilla_overrides.py; do not edit by hand.
# Each movement's extra radicalism factors (neighbouring revolutions, ruler, suffrage...) only apply in
# major powers and player countries. INJECT of a patched copy of additional_radicalism_factors; check
# with the script profiler that 00_ideological_movements.txt radicalism lines disappear.

INJECT:movement_anti_slavery = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		add = movement_radicalism_ruler_is_pro_slavery

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					pop_type_percent_country = {
						target = pop_type:slaves
						value > 0
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				subtract = "owner.average_sol_for_slaves"
				multiply = 0.05
				max = 0.5
				min = -0.25
				desc = "STANDARD_OF_LIVING_FOR_SLAVES"
			}
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_acw_countdown

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_anti_slavery }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_labor = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_institution = institution_social_security }

				add = {
					value = 3
					subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_social_security)"
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_social_security"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_social_security"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_institution = institution_workplace_safety }

				add = {
					value = 3
					subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_labor }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_socialist = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_core_ideology = ideology:ideology_revolutionary_socialist_movement
					had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = yes
				}
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_institution = institution_workplace_safety }
					add = {
						value = 3
						subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
						multiply = 0.05
						desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
							law_enactment_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_worker_protections
								value > neutral
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.1
						desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
			}

			if = { # Support translates 1:1 to Activism
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NAND = {
							has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law = law_type:law_factory_councils
						}
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "SOCIALIST_MOVEMENT_REVOLUTIONARISM"
					value = this.political_movement_support
					max = 0.5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_institution = institution_social_security }

					add = {
						value = 3
						subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_social_security)"
						multiply = 0.05
						desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_social_security"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 0.1
						desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_social_security"
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { has_institution = institution_workplace_safety }
					add = {
						value = 3
						subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
						multiply = 0.05
						desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
							law_enactment_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_worker_protections
								value > neutral
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.1
						desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_socialist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_core_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist_movement
					had_reformist_socialism_victory = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_factory_councils
						country_is_abolishing_factory_councils = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 0.25
					desc = "FACTORY_COUNCILS_BEING_ABOLISHED"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						at_war_with_revolutionary_council_republic = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_REVOLUTIONARY_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
					value = 0.25
				}
			}
		}
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_anarchist = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_factory_councils
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						country_is_abolishing_factory_councils = yes
					}

					add = {
						value = 0.25
						desc = "FACTORY_COUNCILS_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_anarchist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		if = { # Support translates 1:1 to Activism
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NAND = {
						has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
						has_law = law_type:law_factory_councils
					}
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "ANARCHIST_MOVEMENT_REVOLUTIONARISM"
				value = this.political_movement_support
				max = 0.5
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_fascist = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner.number_of_claims > 0
				}

				add = {
					value = 5 # Add a base value for having claims at all
					add = owner.number_of_claims
					multiply = 0.025
					max = 0.3
					desc = "NUMBER_OF_CLAIMS"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_fascist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		if = { # Support translates 1:1 to Activism
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NAND = {
						has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
						ruler.interest_group.party ?= {
							is_party_type = fascist_party
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "FASCIST_MOVEMENT_WILL_TO_POWER"
				add = this.political_movement_support
				max = 0.5
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_liberal = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		add = movement_radicalism_schools_funding
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { has_journal_entry = je_devorismo }
			}
			add = {
				value = 0.2
				desc = "je_devorismo"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
					electoral_confidence < 0.9
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1
				subtract = owner.electoral_confidence
				divide = 5
				multiply = {
					value = 1
					add = owner.modifier:country_electoral_confidence_impact_mult
				}
				desc = "low_electoral_confidence"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_liberal }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_radical = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		add = movement_radicalism_schools_funding
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_institution = institution_police }

				add = {
					value = "institution_investment_level(institution_police)"
					subtract = 2
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_police"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = -0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_police"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "NO_UNIVERSAL_SUFFRAGE"
					value = 0.135
					multiply = {
						value = owner.modifier:state_expected_sol_from_literacy
						multiply = 0.10
						add = 0.5
					}
					min = 0.15
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_russian_revolution
				}
				add = {
					desc = "russian_revolution_radicalism"
					value = 0.15
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
					electoral_confidence < 0.9
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1
				subtract = owner.electoral_confidence
				divide = 5
				desc = "low_electoral_confidence"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_radical }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = wargoal_enforced_by_recognized_power
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "wargoal_pressed_by_recognized_power_tt"
				value = 0.10
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = nationalism
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "unrecognized"
				value = 0.10
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_modernizer }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}

INJECT:movement_anti_communist = {

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = { # Victoria 3 Lite: extra radicalism factors only in major powers and player countries
			limit = { owner ?= { OR = { is_player = yes country_rank >= rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } } }

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					pressing_liberation_wargoal_against_adjacent_country = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "EXPORTING_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.25
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_journal_entry = je_state_and_revolution
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "STATE_AND_REVOLUTION_CONFRONTATION"
				value = "owner.state_and_revolution_political_confrontation_progress"
				add = "owner.state_and_revolution_economic_confrontation_progress"
				divide = 4
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_anti_communist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
			}
	}
}
